purpose: Facts about canli-mcp, the flagship server, as measured in its own repository folder. scripts/build-mcp-head-to-head.mjs publishes them with the benchmark in public/benchmarks/finance-mcp-servers.json, and the homepage prints only what that file holds. The 'current' block is the latest release as measured in its folder; 'benchmarked' is what the head-to-head benchmark ran.

source.note: Tool counts come from mcp-canli/src/index.json at release 0.11; the context figures from mcp-canli/bench/context-2026-10-24-0.11.0.json; the search figures are the 48 held-out everyday requests in mcp-canli/test/search.test.mjs (measured once, untuned, at 0.3.0); the file and batch figures from the README's measurements.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add canli -- npx -y canli-mcp
install.hosted_note: Hosted, no install: add the URL as a connector in claude.ai, ChatGPT or any client that takes one. It serves the public-data and computing tools; file arguments, prices and paper trading need the local server.

front.name: find_tool
front.does: searches every tool by what you ask for

front.name: run_tool
front.does: runs any tool, or up to 25 in one round trip, and draws the result as a view

front.name: history
front.does: a company's reported figure over time, as first reported or as known on a date

front.name: financial_statements
front.does: a company's statements exactly as filed

packs.label: Quant finance
packs.covers: performance and risk, options, fixed income, portfolios, econometrics, indicators and a library of 399 strategy sleeves

packs.label: Backtest validation
packs.covers: deflated Sharpe ratio, overfitting probability, data-snooping tests, leakage checks and placebo tests

packs.label: Markets
packs.covers: SEC filings and statements as filed, insider trades, 13F and 5% holders, fund portfolios, options chains and volatility surfaces, the Fed, Treasury yields and auctions, FRED, World Bank and OECD data, central banks abroad, prediction markets, prices and a whole-market overview

packs.label: SEC fundamentals
packs.covers: company financials as first reported, with later restatements flagged

packs.label: Paper trading
packs.covers: Alpaca paper orders behind pre-trade checks, each check signed

packs.label: Factor backtests
packs.covers: factor backtests that refuse lookahead, a breadth lab that counts its independent bets, parameter sweeps on every core and data annotation

example.note: One real call, run through canli-mcp on 2026-10-10 and copied from its output: run_tool read_filing with the arguments below.
example.match: As of the end of fiscal year 2026, we had approximately 42,000 employees in 38 countries

coverage.method: A question counts when the server lists a tool for it that needs no API key, checked against each server's own tool list. It does not say the answer is right; the head-to-head benchmark measures that.

benchmarked.note: The head-to-head benchmark and its context table measured canli-mcp with 306 tools behind three (config/mcp-head-to-head.json).

current.separately_note: the seven Canli Capital servers run side by side, each listing its own tools

views.label: Market map
views.does: Every index, sector, yield, currency, commodity and crypto as a tile, coloured by its move over a day to a year. Rank them, and a tile opens its chart.

views.label: Yield curve
views.does: The Treasury curve against a month, a year and five years ago, played through five years, with the 10Y-2Y and 10Y-3M spreads and how often it was inverted.

views.label: Compare stocks
views.does: Up to eight tickers: growth of 1, a sortable table of return, volatility, Sharpe, drawdown and beta, and a correlation heatmap that counts the independent bets.

views.label: Statements
views.does: A company's statements as filed, a trend on every line, and one click to margins or growth. Click lines to chart them.

views.label: Volatility surface
views.does: Implied volatility across strikes for each expiry, the term structure, the skew and the whole surface as a heatmap.

views.label: Chart and options
views.does: Candlesticks you zoom and pan, with moving averages, Bollinger bands, RSI and MACD, and the option chain for any expiry.

views.label: Backtest lab
views.does: Growth of 1 against buy-and-hold and the S&P 500, drawdown and trades, sliders that rerun it, and a luck check of every setting tried.

firms: A policy file: which tools and packs may run, orders off, calls a minute.
A tamper-evident audit log of every call, signed with Ed25519 and post-quantum ML-DSA-65, with a signed checkpoint at shutdown; canli-mcp audit verify checks it.
No telemetry. It runs on your machine, keyless by default, and canli://privacy says what each pack sends and stores.
A live feed of SEC filings as they arrive: canli-mcp watch.
